_purpose: Machine-readable actor-based flows สำหรับ AI/coding tools — generate test cases, unit tests, automation
_status: EXAMPLE — requires Complete Jira Story (01-complete-jira-story.json) to be finalized first
_warning: CQ-1 through CQ-5 are still PENDING. Flows referencing those ACs are marked with assumption flags.

actors.admin: User with Can manage posts & comments permission
actors.network: Network layer between app and API

flows.name: View pending posts list
flows.summary: Admin opens Pending tab and sees filtered, sorted, badged post list

steps.action: taps the Pending filter within the Posts tab
shows a loading indicator immediately while fetching data
returns only pending posts from communities admin is assigned to
hides loading indicator and renders post list sorted by created date descending
renders each post card with author avatar, author name, community name, date and time, post content, Approve button, and Decline button
displays badge count of pending posts on the Pending tab label

unit: render Pending tab → assert loading spinner visible before data
mock API with 3 communities (admin assigned to 2) → assert only assigned community posts shown
mock API response → assert posts ordered by created_at DESC
scenario: admin with 2 assigned communities: verify posts from unassigned community absent
6 pending posts: verify sorted latest-first, badge shows 6
e2e: navigate to Pending tab, assert loading indicator visible before list renders
verify badge count matches number of posts rendered

flows.name: Approve post — success
flows.summary: Admin approves a pending post — button disables during request, post removed on success

assumptions.text: Approved post does NOT immediately appear in Posted tab — pending confirmation from CQ-3

steps.action: taps the Approve button on a pending post card
immediately disables the Approve button to prevent double submission
sends POST /posts/{id}/approve to API
validates permission, marks post as approved, returns 200 success
removes the post card from the pending list immediately
decrements the badge count on the Pending tab by 1
shows a success toast notification to the admin

unit: mock approve API success → assert post removed from list, badge decremented by 1
assert Approve button disabled state while request pending
assert success toast triggered on 200 response
scenario: approve single post from list of 3 → verify list shows 2, badge shows 2
verify Approve button disabled during loading state
e2e: tap Approve → assert button disabled → assert post disappears → assert badge -1 → assert toast shown

flows.name: Approve post — network error rollback
flows.summary: Network fails during approve — full rollback, post stays in pending, button re-enabled

steps.action: taps the Approve button on a pending post card
disables Approve button and sends approve request
request fails — connection error or timeout, no response received
shows an error toast to the admin
keeps post in the pending list — no state change on the post
returns Approve button to enabled state so admin can retry

unit: mock approve API network error → assert post still in list
assert Approve button re-enabled after error
assert error toast shown, success toast NOT shown
scenario: simulate offline → tap Approve → verify: post remains, button re-enabled, error toast shown
e2e: use Playwright route interception to simulate network failure on approve
assert post still visible, badge unchanged, Approve button clickable again

flows.name: Post already reviewed — concurrent block
flows.summary: Another admin reviewed the post first — current admin sees informational toast, no action taken

steps.action: taps Approve or Decline on a post that was already reviewed by another admin
rejects the request — post already reviewed, returns conflict error
shows toast: 'Post has been reviewed'
removes the post from the pending list (it is no longer pending)

unit: mock API returning 409 conflict → assert toast 'Post has been reviewed' shown
assert post removed from list on 409 response
scenario: admin A approves post → admin B taps Approve on same post → verify B sees informational toast
e2e: two browser sessions: session A approves, session B taps Decline → assert session B toast message

flows.name: Concurrent conflicting actions — first action wins
flows.summary: Admin A and B act on the same post simultaneously with different actions — first wins

steps.action: taps Approve on the pending post
taps Decline on the same pending post simultaneously
receives admin-A's request first and processes approval
rejects admin-B's request — post already reviewed by admin-A
shows success toast to admin-A
shows error message to admin-B — post has been reviewed

unit: mock concurrent requests with optimistic locking — assert only first write committed
assert idempotency: same post cannot transition from pending twice
scenario: simulate race condition: two approve requests for same post_id → assert only one succeeds
e2e: open two Playwright browser contexts, coordinate simultaneous Approve + Decline on same post
assert one context shows success toast, other shows error message
assert post state in DB is consistent with first-action result

flows.name: No pending posts — empty state
flows.summary: Pending tab has zero posts — either initially or after last post reviewed

steps.action: opens the Pending tab (either fresh or after last post was just actioned)
returns empty list — zero pending posts for assigned communities
displays empty state after data response confirms zero results
hides badge entirely on the Pending tab label — does NOT show 0

unit: mock API returning empty array → assert empty state component rendered
assert badge component not rendered (not just showing 0)
scenario: open Pending tab with no pending posts → verify empty state visible, badge absent
approve last post → verify transition to empty state, badge disappears
e2e: clear all pending posts → navigate to Pending tab → assert empty state, no badge
approve last remaining post → assert empty state appears without page refresh
